How to play

Move
Use Arrow keys, WASD, or the on-screen D-pad.
Solve
Find the key, raise the bridge, and disable the spikes.
Explore
Collect three optional crystals and open the reward chest.
Escape
Reach the portal after all three puzzles are complete.
